About Me ♥

I am Atkiya Maisha, a Computer Science and Engineering graduate from East West University, Bangladesh. My research interests include Green Computing and Sustainable Computing, Design Research, Database Management Systems (DBMS), Data Structures and Algorithms, Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Natural Language Processing (NLP).
